output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    self_contained: true
    theme: cosmo
    highlight: tango
    mathjax: null
    md_extensions: "-tex_math_dollars"
params:
  interactive: true
  sl_summary: ""
  ml_summary: ""
  sl_from_ml: NULL
  loci_coverage: ""
  aa_calls: ""
  unassigned: NULL
  population_assignment: NULL
  population_label: "pop1"
  figures_dir: "figures"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 5
)
source("report_plots.R")

sl_summary <- read_tsv_if_exists(params[["sl_summary"]])
ml_summary <- read_tsv_if_exists(params[["ml_summary"]])
sl_from_ml <- read_tsv_if_exists(params[["sl_from_ml"]])
loci_coverage <- read_tsv_if_exists(params[["loci_coverage"]])
aa_calls <- read_tsv_if_exists(params[["aa_calls"]])
population_assignment <- read_tsv_if_exists(params[["population_assignment"]])
unassigned_specimens <- character()
unassigned_path <- params[["unassigned"]]
if (!is.null(unassigned_path) && file.exists(unassigned_path)) {
  unassigned_specimens <- readLines(unassigned_path)
  unassigned_specimens <- unassigned_specimens[nzchar(trimws(unassigned_specimens))]
}
interactive <- isTRUE(params[["interactive"]])
figures_dir <- params[["figures_dir"]]
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
figures_dir <- normalizePath(figures_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
n_populations <- if (nrow(population_assignment) > 0 && "population" %in% names(population_assignment)) {
  n_distinct(population_assignment$population)
} else {
  1L
}
n_groups <- if (nrow(ml_summary) > 0 && "group_id" %in% names(ml_summary)) {
  n_distinct(ml_summary$group_id)
} else {
  1L
}
n_loci <- if (nrow(loci_coverage) > 0) {
  n_distinct(paste(loci_coverage$gene_id, loci_coverage$aa_position))
} else if (nrow(sl_summary) > 0) {
  n_distinct(sl_summary$variant)
} else {
  1L
}
sanity_dims <- sanity_layout_dims(n_populations)
has_ml_prev <- has_ml_column(ml_summary, "prev")
has_ml_freq <- has_ml_column(ml_summary, "freq")
```

This report is produced at the end of an [nf-core/plasmodiumdrugres](https://nf-co.re/plasmodiumdrugres) run. **Quality Control** plots summarise locus coverage and unassigned specimens. **Sanity checks** compare single-locus frequencies with frequencies recovered from the multi-locus estimates. **Results** plots show single and multi-locus prevalence and frequency.

Figures are `r if (interactive) "interactive (hover to compare values)" else "static PNGs suitable for slides or papers"`. Re-run with `--report_interactive false` for static figures, or `--skip_report` to omit this file.

```{r qc, child='_qc.Rmd'}
```

```{r sanity-checks, child='_sanity_checks.Rmd'}
```

```{r results, child='_results.Rmd'}
```
